mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS total, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 1) AS active, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE t.isolation_mode <> 1) AS dedicated, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 2) AS frozen, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE t.db_version < #{latestVersion}) AS version_behind, COALESCE(SUM(u.rejected_count), 0) AS today_rejected FROM tenant t LEFT JOIN tenant_usage_daily u ON u.tenant_code = t.tenant_code AND u.stat_date = CURRENT_DATE WHERE t.is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT t.tenant_code AS tenant_code, e.company_name AS company_name FROM tenant t LEFT JOIN enterprise e ON e.id = t.enterprise_id AND e.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE t.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY t.tenant_code

SELECT t.tenant_code AS tenant_code, t.status AS status, t.isolation_mode AS isolation_mode, t.schema_name AS schema_name, t.db_version AS db_version, t.upgraded_at AS upgraded_at, t.expire_time AS expire_time, t.create_time AS create_time, e.company_name AS company_name, e.industry AS industry, e.license_no AS license_no, e.legal_person AS legal_person, e.contact_name AS contact_name, COALESCE(q.qps_limit, 0) AS qps_limit, COALESCE(q.daily_request_limit, 0) AS daily_request_limit, COALESCE(q.daily_session_limit, 0) AS daily_session_limit, COALESCE(q.ai_daily_limit, 0) AS ai_daily_limit, COALESCE(q.enabled, FALSE) AS quota_enabled, q.remark AS quota_remark, COALESCE(u.request_count, 0) AS today_requests, COALESCE(u.rejected_count, 0) AS today_rejected, COALESCE(u.session_count, 0) AS today_sessions, COALESCE(u.ai_call_count, 0) AS today_ai_calls FROM tenant t LEFT JOIN enterprise e ON e.id = t.enterprise_id AND e.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN tenant_quota q ON q.tenant_code = t.tenant_code AND q.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN tenant_usage_daily u ON u.tenant_code = t.tenant_code AND u.stat_date = CURRENT_DATE WHERE t.is_deleted = FALSE AND t.tenant_code = #{tenantCode}

SELECT s.id, s.target_schema, s.from_version, s.to_version, s.status, s.script_count, s.applied_scripts, s.message, s.duration_ms, s.operator_name, s.started_at, s.finished_at FROM tenant_schema_upgrade s WHERE s.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} ORDER BY s.started_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_usage_daily (id, tenant_code, stat_date, request_count, rejected_count, session_count, ai_call_count, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantCode}, #{statDate}, #{requestCount}, #{rejectedCount}, #{sessionCount}, #{aiCallCount}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (tenant_code, stat_date) DO UPDATE SET request_count = tenant_usage_daily.request_count + EXCLUDED.request_count, rejected_count = tenant_usage_daily.rejected_count + EXCLUDED.rejected_count, session_count = tenant_usage_daily.session_count + EXCLUDED.session_count, ai_call_count = tenant_usage_daily.ai_call_count + EXCLUDED.ai_call_count, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
